environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with default action, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet with default action, (3) a custom rule with ByteMatchStatement on query string values matching regex patterns for common union/subquery constructs with NONE text transformation applied and BLOCK action. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm all three rule groups are actively evaluating. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to S3 with a 5-minute delivery interval, and a Lambda function triggers on new log delivery to parse and alert on blocked requests via SNS.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALBv2 with WAFv2 WebACL association

wafv2_web_acl_rules.name: custom-sqli-query-param-block
wafv2_web_acl_rules.statement: byte_match on QUERY_STRING with regex_pattern_set containing UNION|SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP|EXEC|--|;|0x with URL_DECODE and LOWERCASE transforms

config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet
config.monitoring: CloudWatch WAF metrics active, ALB access logs to S3, Lambda alerting on blocks
